Subject: Vendor activation playbook — draft & procurement kickoff

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed vendor activation playbook (attachment: Novatech_MAP_v1.xlsx) so procurement and our teams can align on the supplier setup. This is a working draft — please flag anything that’s off.

High-level milestones (draft):
- Supplier registration (Ariba/Coupa): Owner: Novatech procurement; Target: 2026-04-12; Dependencies: supplier ID, W-9, bank details
- Contract signing (DocuSign): Owner: Lauren (Redwood Legal); Target: 2026-04-15; Dependencies: SOW, pricing confirmation
- Security & compliance handoff (SOC2 evidence if requested): Owner: Ben/Marissa; Target: 2026-04-16; Dependencies: questionnaire completion
- Integration & staging access: Owner: Marissa (Redwood); Target: 2026-04-20; Dependencies: API key, staging IP allowlist
- Go-live (production enablement): Owner: Novatech + Redwood ops; Target close: 2026-04-23; Dependencies: payments/banking established, Ariba supplier ID

Attachments: Novatech_MAP_v1.xlsx (tabs: milestones, owners, doc links). I pulled the target close date into the header; we can slide it depending on procurement windows.

Asks for Novatech before our next sync:
1) Confirm whether you want us to onboard via Ariba supplier portal or Coupa (we can support both).
2) Please provide the procurement contact who will complete supplier registration (email and preferred onboarding window).
3) Upload W-9 and bank routing/instruction files to the procurement portal (or send secure link). If you prefer, we can accept a W-9 as an attachment to this thread for speed.

I'll schedule a 30-minute procurement sync for next week to walk through the milestones if that works.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Ben — appreciate the tight recap and the draft MAP. A few quick notes from procurement side:

- We use Ariba as our primary supplier portal. Procurement will create the supplier record once they have the W-9 and banking instructions.
- Procurement contact: Sasha Patel (sasha.patel@novatech.com) — she’s CC’d here (procurement@novatech.com forwards to the team).
- I’m attaching the completed W-9 for Novatech (W9_Novatech.pdf) — that should be what your procurement team needs to start the supplier setup.

Banking: our finance team requests that banking details be uploaded directly to Ariba’s secure supplier banking form. They do not accept banking data over email for security reasons; procurement will notify you when the supplier record is ready and provide the supplier ID.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm which Redwood entity will appear on invoices (company and tax info)?
2) We'll want a brief integration checklist so our SREs know what to expect for staging IPs and sample payloads.

— Alex
Alex Romero

Novatech Systems
